ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee; no refund. Note the driver's 90-day record (2 upheld no-show disputes, 3 disputes) for routine monitoring only.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider says she came out a minute after the cancellation, implying the fee is unfair; GPS shows the driver was at the pickup point (~40 m) from 09:56:20 and waited 3 min 05 s before cancelling at 09:59:25, so the NS-1 conditions (I'm Here + within pickup range + >3 min wait) are all met on system records.
